judgment.notes: The complete P signature retains exactly the four mathematical parameters and H001–H006. Positive integer dimensions correspond in both directions to n,m : ℕ with 1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m; neither spatial nor target dimension is dropped. u and q inhabit the corresponding real Euclidean spaces. H002 constrains joint smoothness only on {p | 0 < p.2}; H003 and H004 separately retain q's unit norm and u's pointwise unit norm. H005 quantifies x,t first, then a : ℝ existentially at that point; it assumes neither a regular scalar field nor the derived explicit equation. H006 retains one globally fixed q and, for each 0 < s < t, a compact C valid for every r in the entire closed interval, including endpoints. Real endpoints need no separate finiteness hypothesis. There are no external E ports, additional project hypotheses, object/structure parameters, or shared assumed obligations. The transitive direct boundaries are preserved: T001/T002 use only R001's H002,H004,H005; T003 uses R002's H001,H002,H006; T004 uses H002 and T005 adds T003/T004 within R003; T006 uses H001 and T007 uses H001,H002,T003,T006 within R004; T008 uses T002,T003,T005,T007 and T009 only T008 within R005. Every added conditional input has an earlier producer; none survives as an extra premise of P. The domain is nonvacuous: constant u=q with a unit q satisfies the original and encoded hypotheses.

Reviewed all five canonical inferences and all 22 source paragraphs against the nine typed steps. S001–S003 are T001/T002: unit-constraint differentiation, pointwise normality, and the complete explicit-equation consequence N001. S004–S007 are T003, retaining the same existential C,R throughout each time window and every clause of N002. S008 is T004; S009–S014 are T005, preserving the compact-cylinder bound, guarded difference quotients, two-sided mean value estimate, punctured-filter dominated convergence, and integrable linearity of R003. S015–S019 are T007 with implementation bridge T006 for S018: the flux product rule, zero endpoint values, one-dimensional FTC, coordinate-measure identification, Fubini, and extension from the box to all space. S020–S021 are T008's cancellation; S022 is T009's three order cases and mean value theorem. N001–N004 and the complete P all have their full exported content represented. T004 and T006 extract source calculations rather than introduce a new proof route. Background notes remain references, and Mathlib is available without an M-registration audit. This is interface/plan acceptance, not certification of unprovided proof bodies.
